## Checklist

- [ ] Every changed plugin has a higher version in its manifest and matching catalog entry.
- [ ] `npm ci`, `npm test`, and `npm run validate` pass.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs --base <base-commit-sha>` passes.
- [ ] Skill names, descriptions, bodies, and authored supporting documents are English.
- [ ] Skill names are unique and do not use the assistant template's four reserved names.
- [ ] The catalog still contains exactly the two workshop plugins.
- [ ] No secrets, personal identifiers, or development-copy repository references are included.
- [ ] Redistribution rights and required license/attribution notices are preserved.
- [ ] Vendored changes were generated by the pinned-commit script, not edited manually.
- [ ] Any unperformed live installation or skill checks are marked below.
